protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: js_typed_array_constructor snapshots offset and len from a resizable ArrayBuffer, then js_create_from_ctor reads new_target.prototype and can run a getter that shrinks the buffer. Before the fix, typed_array_init uses the stale geometry and sets the view pointer and count without revalidation. Issue #1296 supplies this exact PoC and an ASAN heap-buffer-overflow trace whose allocation stack passes through js_array_buffer_resize.
